c04_recommended_amendment.name: UTC_YEAR_DISTRIBUTIONAL_VARIATION_CANDIDATE
c04_recommended_amendment.statement: Within the admitted 2021-05-25 through 2026-05-24 corpus, the predeclared UTC_YEAR bucket distributions differ descriptively across years for minute_range, tick_count, and spread_mean. The 2025-2026 spread_mean central quantiles differ sharply from earlier year buckets while p99 remains near prior-year levels. This is a retrospective descriptive variation candidate only; formal temporal instability, nonstationarity, structural break, cause, persistence, and generalization remain untested.

stop_reason: Distinct human decisions are required before SI-02 can be closed.
